title: potentilla tilingii var. flavescens
intro: Potentilla tilingii var. flavescens, commonly known as Golden Potentilla, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and oxidative stress, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla tilingii var. flavescens include reducing inflammation, fighting against free radicals, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
